findings.basis: AOSP CarrierConfig assets in this tree: carrier id 1839 Verizon Wireless and the Xfinity ids 2032/2556 carry exactly these ten entries. Samsung stock carrier config (SM-S942B EUX firmware) carries the same ten for Visible, Tracfone-VZW, Spectrum (310-599) and Spectrum on 313-450. Real Verizon-network settings; the Google lane carries the same set plus one entry.
findings.effect: Parsing: ImsPhoneCallTracker reads each 'FROM|MESSAGE|TO' entry (ImsPhoneCallTracker.java:2022-2061). FROM is an ImsReasonInfo code, not a raw SIP status. '*' as FROM matches by message only and needs a non-empty message (3263). An empty MESSAGE ('332||338') matches every message for that code, because the ArrayMap lookup calls key.equals(stored) and the lower-cased actual message only has to start with the stored text (1211-1250, 3243-3291; ArrayMap.java:140-176). Use: maybeRemapReasonCode feeds only getDisconnectCauseFromReasonInfo (3298-3485), the precise cause (3488-3491) and two metrics calls (3612-3618, 3779-3783). Every redial decision reads the raw, unmapped ImsReasonInfo: CS retry on CODE_LOCAL_CALL_CS_RETRY_REQUIRED (3625-3683), alternate emergency 1514 and the Wi-Fi E911 auto retry (3791-3816), RTT-off retry 3001 (3817-3820), the reasonInfo stored by conn.setImsReasonInfo (3635, 3789) that TelephonyConnection and maybeReselectDomain hand to domain selection (TelephonyConnection.java:2575-2611; TelephonyConnectionService.java:3103-3118), EmergencyCallDomainSelector's retry-code list and TEMP/PERM switch (EmergencyCallDomainSelector.java:561-577, 1829-1835) and NormalCallDomainSelector's CS redial (NormalCallDomainSelector.java:334-350), which covers WPS, TTY and RTT calls. The mapped code reaches emergency handling through four doors only: (1) the non-domain-selection path redials on another slot only for DisconnectCause EMERGENCY_TEMP_FAILURE or EMERGENCY_PERM_FAILURE (from codes 363/364) (TelephonyConnection.java:2615-2626); (2) maybeReselectDomainForEmergencyCall skips reselection when the DisconnectCause is LOCAL (from 501) or POWER_OFF (from 111/1500) (TelephonyConnectionService.java:3131-3146); (3) ImsPhoneConnection.onDisconnect lets INCOMING_REJECTED (from 143, 1017, 1404) replace the LOCAL that a user hang-up set (ImsPhoneConnection.java:555-566), which feeds door 2; (4) EmergencyCallDomainSelector.getDisconnectCause starts from the mapped precise cause (its TEMP/PERM switch reads the raw code, and the IMS map gives IMS_EMERGENCY_TEMP/PERM 1342/1343, not the 325/326 it tests) and ends selection on NO_VALID_SIM, which the map gives for code 1501 (445-470, 561-577, 1819-1845). Everything else the mapped code changes is shown or logged: Telecom code, label, description and tone (DisconnectCauseUtil.java:138-262), call-log type and missed-call notification (CallLogManager.java:160-176; ImsPhoneCallTracker.java:3736-3758), metrics, and Telecom's auto-unhold of a held non-emergency call after a new call fails in setup with code ERROR (CallsManagerCallSequencingAdapter.java:246-253); new non-emergency calls are aborted during an emergency call (CallsManager.java:2379-2392), so that cannot touch a held emergency call. Telecom's retry on a create failure ignores the code (CreateConnectionProcessor.java:643-653) and EmergencyStateTracker never reads the disconnect cause. On this build domain selection is off (config_domain_selection_service_component_name empty, no device overlay; DomainSelectionResolver.java:139-146), so the live emergency paths are the raw-code CS retry and door 1; doors 2-4 matter if 24.0 or a later overlay turns domain selection on. AOSP ImsStack: the extra message is the Reason header text (enrich flag true, carrier_config.xml:314; CallReasonInfo.h:325-354; Q.850 texts arrive as 'q.850;...'). A CANCEL already becomes 1014 for 'call completion elsewhere' or cause 200 and 1017 for 'another device sent all devices busy response' or cause 600/603 (CancelHandler.cpp:26-27, 62-86); a BYE saying 'call has been pulled by another device' already becomes 1016 (TerminationHandler.cpp). An emergency INVITE failure becomes CS retry 146 with an empty message by default, or 363/364 with an empty message, and a SIP code with Reason text only where the ImsStack's per-carrier emergency reject table says terminate (EmergencyStartErrorHandler.cpp:72-141). The ImsStack itself never reads this key (also on branch ocd). Entries of this value: '332|simultaneous call limit has already been reached|1403': 403 with that text: SERVER_ERROR -> MAXIMUM_NUMBER_OF_CALLS_REACHED; both Telecom ERROR; only the label changes; no door. '332|Forbidden: Simultaneous Call Limit Has Already Been Reached|1403': Same as the previous entry with the 'Forbidden:' text; only the label changes; no door. '338|another device sent all devices busy response|1404': 486 with the multi-device busy text: BUSY -> INCOMING_REJECTED (Telecom REJECTED). Only door 3 in theory: a user hang-up crossing such a 486 would stop counting as a local hang-up for emergency reselection. That needs domain selection on and a PSAP answering an emergency INVITE with a multi-device busy text, and the AOSP ImsStack turns an emergency INVITE failure into 146 first. Incoming calls: shown and logged as rejected. '501|call completion elsewhere|1014': USER_TERMINATED with that text: LOCAL -> ANSWERED_ELSEWHERE. A real hang-up keeps LOCAL (onDisconnect only lets INCOMING_REJECTED replace it), and the AOSP ImsStack gives 501 only for a local action, without such a Reason text. Label and call log only. '501|call has been pulled by another device|1016': LOCAL -> CALL_PULLED with that text; not producible by a local hang-up on the AOSP ImsStack; label and call log only. '510|call has been pulled by another device|1016': NORMAL -> CALL_PULLED; the ImsStack TerminationHandler already gives 1016 for this text; label and call log only. '501|another device sent all devices busy response|1404': LOCAL -> INCOMING_REJECTED. Door 3 would need 501 carrying that text, which the AOSP ImsStack never produces for a local hang-up (no incoming Reason header). Label and call log only in practice. '510|another device sent all devices busy response|1404': NORMAL -> INCOMING_REJECTED for an incoming call cancelled with that text (the ImsStack already gives 1017, also INCOMING_REJECTED). Label and call log only. '1014|call has been pulled by another device|1016': ANSWERED_ELSEWHERE -> CALL_PULLED; label and call log only. '*|Call is dropped due to Wi-Fi signal is degraded|1407': Any code whose message starts with that text -> WIFI_LOST (Telecom ERROR). The text is an internal message of the Pixel IMS stack; the AOSP ImsStack only passes Reason header text, and its emergency codes 146/363/364 carry an empty message, which the '*' form never matches (ImsPhoneCallTracker.java:3263). No redial path keys on WIFI_LOST. Label only.
findings.risk: Compared with the Google-lane Verizon-family value (nine profiles, and 310-012's first entry): only drops 510+'Call Completion Elsewhere' -> 1014, which the ImsStack CancelHandler already does natively. Compared with ['510|Call completed elsewhere|1014'] (310-012's second entry and 313-450 Spectrum data): adds the nine multi-device entries and the Wi-Fi '*' entry and drops the 510 'completed elsewhere' entry; each is read above as label, tone or call-log only. No entry of this value has 363, 364, 146, 1514 or 3001 as its source or 501, 111, 1500, 1501, 363 or 364 as its target, so doors 1, 2 and 4 stay shut; any door-3 case needs a busy/decline Reason text on an emergency INVITE that the AOSP ImsStack turns into 146 first. Emergency, TTY, RTT and WPS calls are placed, routed, retried and called back the same way; only the shown reason, tone and call-log class can differ.

notes: Proceed. Against the Google lane the only change is one entry the ImsStack already applies itself; against the 510-only lane the added entries are Verizon multi-device and Wi-Fi labels that no emergency, TTY, RTT or WPS path reads. The basis is AOSP and Samsung Verizon-family config.
